plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero for capital preservation.
Exit high-beta, below-stop names (METU, MSFU, PLTU, MUU) to reduce risk.
Trim SPY to 20% to meet the single-name concentration mandate.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation and reduces overall portfolio risk.
conservative.read: This conservative plan targets a modest ~1.5% per month, focusing on capital preservation. It significantly reduces drawdown risk by cutting leveraged and high-beta positions. Expect lower volatility and more stable returns.

plan: Trim high-beta and leveraged positions (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to reduce overall risk.
Trim SPY to 25% to comply with the single-name concentration mandate.
Buy NVDD at 4% as a top-scoring scanner setup to add quality growth.
This plan balances risk and growth, maintaining a small leveraged ETF presence.
balanced.read: This balanced plan aims for ~2.5% per month, prioritizing risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding a high-quality scanner setup. Expect moderate volatility and growth potential.

plan: Add to high-beta and leveraged positions (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to increase growth potential.
Trim SPY to 25% to comply with the single-name concentration mandate.
Buy NVDD at 6% as a top-scoring scanner setup, leveraging strong signals.
This plan aggressively leans into leverage and concentration for higher potential returns.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4% per month, aiming for stretched growth. It significantly increases leverage and concentration, leading to higher potential upside but also much larger drawdowns. Leveraged ETFs decay daily; strict stop discipline is crucial.

plan: Sell all high-beta and leveraged positions (METU, MSFU, SOXL, SPAL, PLTU, MUU) to near zero.
Trim SPY to 25% to comply with the single-name concentration mandate.
Add to QQQI, increasing income exposure for steady monthly distributions.
This plan prioritizes low drawdown and reliable income over growth.
income.read: This income plan targets ~1% per month, focusing on parking cash for yield. It significantly reduces growth-oriented and leveraged positions for stability. Distributions are variable, and NAV can still fall in selloffs; this is not a savings account.
